Package io.telekom.orchest.api.core.model.bpmn.state

Interface ExecutionStateKey<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of value stored under this key
All Known Implementing Classes:
ExecutionStateKey.CallActivityChild, ExecutionStateKey.CallActivityChildCounter, ExecutionStateKey.DecisionInstance, ExecutionStateKey.EventGatewayCatchEvents, ExecutionStateKey.EventGatewayLinkedId, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceLoopCounter, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceLoopSize, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceSubProcessCompleted, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceSubProcessOutput, ExecutionStateKey.ParallelGatewayToken, ExecutionStateKey.PendingIncidentResolution, ExecutionStateKey.UserTaskId
public sealed interface ExecutionStateKey<T> permits ExecutionStateKey.ParallelGatewayToken, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceLoopSize, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceLoopCounter, ExecutionStateKey.EventGatewayLinkedId, ExecutionStateKey.EventGatewayCatchEvents, ExecutionStateKey.CallActivityChild, ExecutionStateKey.CallActivityChildCounter, ExecutionStateKey.DecisionInstance, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceSubProcessOutput, ExecutionStateKey.MultiInstanceSubProcessCompleted, ExecutionStateKey.PendingIncidentResolution, ExecutionStateKey.UserTaskId
Sealed interface for type-safe execution state keys. Replaces magic string concatenation scattered across the codebase with discoverable, compile-time-checked key types.

The underlying storage remains Map<String, Object> (for MongoDB compatibility), but access through these keys provides type safety at call sites via ProcessInstance typed accessors (getState, putState, removeState, containsState).
